channel.title: Copilot CLI on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Copilot CLI on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.112
item.description:
Release v1.0.112 focuses on terminal/UI reliability, clearer error handling, and MCP/plugin/session fixes across narrow terminals, sidebar dialogs, and prompt flows. It also updates model selection defaults, session limit handling, and startup behavior, with additional improvements to copy/paste formatting and Unicode rendering.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.111
item.description:
Release v1.0.111 adds new permission-rule regex support, a one-time remote host session creation flag, and several MCP/plugin/workflow/session fixes. It also includes many terminal UI, rendering, and reliability fixes across /usage, /diff, /resume, search, paste handling, and startup/sign-in flows.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: C++ language server now auto-configures MSBuild builds
item.description:
The Microsoft C++ Language Server for GitHub Copilot CLI now includes its MSBuild compile commands extractor and runs it automatically. This removes the need for an agent to discover and invoke the extractor separately.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.108
item.description:
Release v1.0.108 adds numerous CLI behavior fixes, help-text updates, and MCP/autopilot improvements. Notable changes include better session/resume handling, more consistent permission and tool-call behavior, improved search and transcript rendering, and default installation/activation for managed plugins marked defaultEnabled.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.107
item.description:
Release v1.0.107 adds many CLI, terminal, sandbox, MCP, model-picker, and session-management fixes. Notable changes include inline image support in Rex terminals, a new /code command, a unified /settings dashboard with global search, and numerous corrections for Windows, Unicode, control-character handling, resumable sessions, and authentication flows.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: Repository plugin defaults and enterprise plugin controls generally available
item.description:
Repository plugin defaults and enterprise-managed plugin controls are now generally available for VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the GitHub Copilot app. Trusted repositories can install and enable default plugins, and enterprises can manage plugin controls centrally.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.105
item.description:
Copilot CLI v1.0.105 fixes /model selection so Copilot Fusion High or Max can now be chosen from long-context sessions. This change affects model switching behavior in those sessions.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.103
item.description:
Release v1.0.103 fixes session, sandbox, and model-default handling, and improves response copying, reconnect behavior, and MCP/worktree reuse. It also updates remote launch flags and several tool-call edge cases.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.102
item.description:
Release 1.0.102 updates Copilot CLI behavior around model selection, permissions, plugin sources, shell completion, chat flow, retry handling, and sandbox networking. It also fixes a few reliability issues in subagent workflows, long-running sandboxed commands, and provider overload retries.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.101
item.description:
Release v1.0.101 adds several CLI and MCP workflow fixes, including native structured output for dynamic workflow subagents on supported models, new assisted approval instructions, and more reliable sign-in and permission handling. It also fixes model selection, session resume/startup behavior, Windows/macOS shell command issues, and multiple provider-specific request and image-limit problems.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.100
item.description:
Release v1.0.100 adds new CLI flags and session/share commands, expands plugin and sandbox handling, and improves account, permission, and model management flows. It also fixes a wide range of reliability issues across MCP, Gemini, Windows, proxy, telemetry, and session browsing.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.97
item.description:
Release v1.0.97 adds agent-scoped declarative hooks, improves plugin/MCP handling, and fixes multiple session, permissions, and UI issues. It also changes inline images to render by default on supported terminals and includes several data/output correctness fixes.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: Dynamic workflows in Copilot CLI and the Copilot app
item.description:
Dynamic workflows are now available in Copilot CLI, the GitHub Copilot app, and the GitHub Copilot SDK. They let you define an orchestration in code.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — September 7
item.description:
GitHub Copilot’s Sept. 7 weekly release adds Jira integration in Copilot app and adaptive model orchestration via Project HydraFusion in Copilot CLI. It also introduces new agent automation in Visual Studio Code.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is generally available. The release adds new platform capabilities, including administrator configuration for Copilot CLI.

  • Source: GitHub
